ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between dominant low-intensity (black/dark gray) fluke body and high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters. Approximate distribution ratio of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous mass covering >90% of both lobes. Discrete white annular blobs (rosettes) scattered across mid-sections. Mid-intensity gray mottling observed at the base of the median notch and along narrow strips of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 25 pixels, with the most pronounced irregularity on the distal half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer boundaries exhibit a strong convex curvature from the insertion point to the tips, creating a broad, fan-like lobe geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of 20+ distinct, high-contrast white circular ring clusters distributed across the ventral surface; significant clustering on the medial portion of the left lobe and lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the lower left lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch (tissue deficit) on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive circular scarring across both lobes consistent with historic barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'leopard-print' patterning caused by high-contrast white circular scars against a near-uniform black background.
